Search_api_b17ef6d.name: Search_api_b17ef6d
Search_api_b17ef6d.description: Search for product offers using various filtering parameters such as rating, condition, shipping speed, price, and more. Supports both free-form queries and GTIN/EAN identifiers with infinite pagination.

min_rating_.description: Return products with rating greater than the specified value. Possible values: '1', '2', '3', '4'.

product_condition_.description: Only return products with a specific condition. Possible values: 'NEW', 'USED', 'REFURBISHED'.

max_shipping_days_.description: Only return product offers that offer shipping/delivery within a specified number of days.

store_id_.description: Only return product offers from specific stores (comma-separated list of store IDs). Store IDs can be obtained from the Google Shopping URL after using the Seller filter.

on_sale_.description: Only return product offers that are currently on sale. Default is None.

free_returns_.description: Only return product offers that offer free returns. Default is None.

free_shipping_.description: Only return product offers that offer free shipping/delivery. Default is None.

max_price_.description: Only return product offers with price lower than a certain value.

language_.description: The language of the results. Default is 'en'. Valid values: see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_639-1_codes.

sort_by_.description: Sort product offers by best match, top rated, lowest or highest price. Possible values: 'BEST_MATCH', 'TOP_RATED', 'LOWEST_PRICE', 'HIGHEST_PRICE'.

country_.description: Country code of the region/country to return offers for. Default is 'us'. Valid values: see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2.

min_price_.description: Only return product offers with price greater than a certain value.

page_.description: Results page to return. Default is 1.

type_.description: Filters places by `type`. Specifiable values are 'CITY', 'ADMIN_DIVISION_1', 'ADMIN_DIVISION_2', and 'COUNTRY'. Default is 'CITY'.

language_.description: Specifies the language (ISO 639-1) to get the localized name of the place. If translation is unavailable, the "localizedName" property will be null.

skip_.description: Number of places to ignore before beginning to return results. Used with `limit` to paginate results. Defaults to 0.

country_.description: Filters places by their country `id`. Multiple values can be specified, separated by commas (e.g., 'US,CA'). Default is 'US,CA'.

limit_.description: Maximum number of places to return. Used with `skip` to paginate results. Default is 10, maximum is 100.

admindivision1_.description: Filters places by their adminDivision1 `id`. Multiple values can be specified, separated by commas (e.g., 'US.CA,US.DE').

admindivision2_.description: Filters places by their adminDivision2 `id`. Multiple values can be specified, separated by commas.

accuracyradiuskm_.description: Maximum radius (in kilometers) from the point specified by `latitude` and `longitude` to filter places located within the area. Default is 100 km.

latitude_.description: Latitude coordinate to filter places by location. Ignored if `longitude` is not specified.

q_.description: Query string to find places with a similar name. Default is 'New York'.

longitude_.description: Longitude coordinate to filter places by location. Ignored if `latitude` is not specified.

uuid_.description: UUID of the cryptocurrency for which the price is needed.

timestamp_.description: Epoch timestamp in seconds for the specific price time. Defaults to the latest price if not provided.

referencecurrencyuuid_.description: UUID of the reference currency in which the price is shown. Defaults to US Dollar ('yhjMzLPhuIDl').

Whois_lookup_api.name: Whois_lookup_api
Whois_lookup_api.description: Performs a WHOIS lookup for the given domain using the Toolbench RapidAPI service and returns the data in JSON format.

domain_.description: The domain name to be looked up.

Get_country_details_api_6b86b27.name: Get_country_details_api_6b86b27
Get_country_details_api_6b86b27.description: Fetch details of a country using its name and optionally its prefix.

name_.description: The name of the country to retrieve details for.

prefix_match_.description: If set to True, the search will match based on the prefix of the country name. Defaults to None.

Sizes_all_countries_api.name: Sizes_all_countries_api
Sizes_all_countries_api.description: Gets the size information of countries in Africa based on the specified country name.

country_name_.description: The name of the country for which to get the size information. Use 'all' to get size information for all countries.

Markets_api.name: Markets_api
Markets_api.description: Retrieves the market countries supported by the service, used by suppliers to set fares based on the market (or country of purchase). The names of the markets returned are localized based on the provided locale.

locale_.description: Locale of the request. The names of the returned markets are localized based on this parameter.

Products_api_d4735e3.name: Products_api_d4735e3
Products_api_d4735e3.description: Search for makeup products based on various filters and criteria.

price_less_than_.description: Filter products with a price less than the given value.

product_type_.description: Filter products by the specified type (e.g., foundation, mascara).

product_tags_.description: Filter products based on specific tags.

brand_.description: The brand of the products to filter by, default is 'colourpop'.

rating_less_than_.description: Filter products with a rating less than the given value.

product_category_.description: Sub-category of makeup products (e.g., 'lipstick'), default is 'lipstick'.

price_greater_than_.description: Filter products with a price greater than the given value.

rating_greater_than_.description: Filter products with a rating greater than the given value.

Serp_api.name: Serp_api
Serp_api.description: Fetches search engine results using the given query and optional parameters.

query_.description: The search query to be sent to the search engine.

proxy_.description: The country to use as a proxy for the search. Defaults to 'US'.

max_.description: The maximum number of search results to return. Defaults to 10.

V1_validatephone_api.name: V1_validatephone_api
V1_validatephone_api.description: Validates a given phone number and returns metadata using the API Ninjas Validate Phone API.

number_.description: The phone number to validate. If `country` is not specified, the phone number must include the 3-digit country code prefix.

country_.description: The 2-letter ISO-3166 country code corresponding to the phone number.

Market_get_full_api.name: Market_get_full_api
Market_get_full_api.description: Retrieves comprehensive information about specified stock tickers using the Bloomberg Finance API.

is_id_.description: A comma-separated string of ticker IDs corresponding to the desired stocks. These IDs are returned by the `/market/auto-complete` endpoint.

Get_financial_time_series_daily_api.name: Get_financial_time_series_daily_api
Get_financial_time_series_daily_api.description: Fetches synthetic financial time series data (Date, Price Return) for a specified symbol and asset class.

symbol_.description: The symbol identifying the financial instrument (e.g., '0001').

asset_class_.description: The category of the financial instrument (e.g., equity, bond, commodity, mixed).

size_.description: The size of the data set to return. Options are 'compact' for the most recent 252 data points, or 'full' for all available data. Defaults to 'full'.

Elhighlights_api.name: Elhighlights_api
Elhighlights_api.description: Fetches football highlights from a specified API endpoint.

url_.description: The API endpoint URL for fetching highlights. Defaults to 'https://acrtadeon.elhighlights.com/embed/0nvR19fByJZmp'.

V1_caloriesburned_api.name: V1_caloriesburned_api
V1_caloriesburned_api.description: Fetches the number of calories burned for a given activity using the API Ninjas Calories Burned API.

activity_.description: The name of the activity. Partial values are allowed (e.g., 'ski' will match both 'water skiing' and 'downhill skiing').

weight_.description: Weight of the user in pounds (must be between 50 and 500). Defaults to None.

duration_.description: Duration of the activity in minutes (must be 1 or greater). Defaults to None.

Image_search_api_4e07408.name: Image_search_api_4e07408
Image_search_api_4e07408.description: Performs an image search using the provided query and optional parameters.

q_.description: The search query term.

gl_.description: A two-letter country code that boosts search results from the specified country. Defaults to 'US'.

lr_.description: Restricts the search to documents written in a particular language. Defaults to 'lang_en'.

start_.description: The index of the first result to return. Defaults to 0.

num_.description: The number of search results to return, between 1 and 20 inclusive. Defaults to 10.

Search_api_2858dcd.name: Search_api_2858dcd
Search_api_2858dcd.description: Perform a search query using specified parameters and returns the search results in JSON format.

q_.description: The search query.

safesearch_.description: Level of safe search filter to apply. Defaults to '0'.

categories_.description: Categories to restrict the search to. Defaults to 'general'.

time_range_.description: Time range to restrict the search results. Defaults to 'None'.

language_.description: Language to restrict search results. Defaults to 'de-DE'.

url_.description: Webhook URL for POST requests. Defaults to 'https://engine.corrently.cloud/webhook-test/44a17c5c-5087-483f-8398-dedbc8d713d4'.

List_accounts_api.name: List_accounts_api
List_accounts_api.description: Fetches a list of accounts from the API, optionally paginated by a specified page number.

page_.description: The page number for paginated results. Defaults to None.

Using_path_parameters_api.name: Using_path_parameters_api
Using_path_parameters_api.description: This function makes a request to an API endpoint to split a given text based on specified parameters and returns the response.

text_.description: The input text to be split.

max_size_.description: The maximum size limit for the split text. Defaults to 1024.

delimiter_.description: The delimiter to be used for splitting the text. Defaults to None.

include_variations_.description: Whether to include variations in the splitting process. Defaults to None.

Basketball_search_api.name: Basketball_search_api
Basketball_search_api.description: Search for basketball players, teams, and tournaments using the provided term.

term_.description: The search term used to look for players, teams, and tournaments.

Stock_get_stock_earnings_data_api.name: Stock_get_stock_earnings_data_api
Stock_get_stock_earnings_data_api.description: Fetches the stock earnings data for a given symbol and region using the RapidAPI service.

symbol_.description: The ticker symbol of the stock (e.g., "AAPL" for Apple Inc.).

region_.description: The region code for the stock market (default is 'US'). Allowed values include US, BR, AU, CA, FR, DE, HK, IN, IT, ES, GB, and S.

Get_user_data_api.name: Get_user_data_api
Get_user_data_api.description: Fetches user data from the Discord API using a given user ID.

is_id_.description: The ID of the user whose data is being fetched.

Additional_title_details_api.name: Additional_title_details_api
Additional_title_details_api.description: Fetch additional details for a movie or TV show based on its IMDb ID.

imdbid_.description: The IMDb ID of the movie or TV show.

Teams_get_tournaments_api.name: Teams_get_tournaments_api
Teams_get_tournaments_api.description: Retrieve the tournaments attended by a specific team.

teamid_.description: The ID of the team for which to retrieve tournament information.

Leaguetotalteamevents_api_6b86b27.name: Leaguetotalteamevents_api_6b86b27
Leaguetotalteamevents_api_6b86b27.description: Retrieves the total team events for a specific cricket league and season.

tournamentid_.description: The unique tournament ID for which the total team events are to be retrieved.

seasonid_.description: The season ID for which the total team events are to be retrieved.

Search_api_2fca346.name: Search_api_2fca346
Search_api_2fca346.description: Fetches search results from the YouTube V3 Lite API based on specified criteria.

part_.description: The part parameter specifies a comma-separated list of one or more search resource properties.

q_.description: The search query term.

x_cachebypass_.description: Bypasses the cache if set to '1'. Defaults to None.

videoduration_.description: The video duration. Options are 'any', 'short', 'medium', 'long'. Defaults to 'any'.

videodefinition_.description: The video quality definition. Options are 'any', 'high'. Defaults to 'any'.

videocaption_.description: The video captions. Options are 'any', 'closedCaption'. Defaults to 'any'.

videolicense_.description: The video license. Options are 'any', 'creativeCommon'. Defaults to 'any'.

eventtype_.description: The event type. Options are 'any', 'live'. Defaults to 'any'.

type_.description: The event type. Options are 'any', 'live'. Defaults to 'any'.

order_.description: The sorting order of the results. Options are 'relevance', 'date', 'viewCount', 'rating'. Defaults to 'relevance'.

videotype_.description: The type of video. Options are 'any', 'episode', 'movie'. Defaults to 'any'.

Latest_api_d4735e3.name: Latest_api_d4735e3
Latest_api_d4735e3.description: Fetches the latest showerthoughts from the showerthoughts subReddit using the RapidAPI service.

num_.description: The number of showerthoughts to fetch. Defaults to 10. Must be between 1 and 500.

Get_quotes_by_character_name_api.name: Get_quotes_by_character_name_api
Get_quotes_by_character_name_api.description: Fetch quotes from the Anime Quotes API for a given character name.

name_.description: The name of the character for whom to fetch quotes.

page_.description: The page number to retrieve, used for pagination. Defaults to 1.

Getorderbyid_api_7902699.name: Getorderbyid_api_7902699
Getorderbyid_api_7902699.description: Fetch the details of an order using its ID from the specified API.

orderid_.description: ID of the order that needs to be fetched. Valid IDs are integers with a value >= 1 and <= 10.

Loginuser_api_4fc82b2.name: Loginuser_api_4fc82b2
Loginuser_api_4fc82b2.description: Logs a user into the pet store system using the provided credentials and RapidAPI key.

username_.description: The username for login.

password_.description: The password for login in clear text.

Sport_translations_api.name: Sport_translations_api
Sport_translations_api.description: Fetch sport translations for a given sport ID and language using the Pinaculo API.

is_id_.description: The ID of the sport for which translations are to be retrieved.

lang_.description: The language code in which translations should be fetched.

Timeline_api.name: Timeline_api
Timeline_api.description: Fetches the 100 most recent articles and their keywords using the Papercliff RapidAPI.

is_from_.description: Narrows down the results to articles published after the provided date-time in UTC. The format should be `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm`. Example value: `2022-09-18T13:45`. Date-times older than a week do not affect the result.

terms_.description: Narrows down the results to articles that contain all the provided keywords. The terms should consist of one to three words separated by a dash. Example value: `election-campaign`.

offset_.description: Omits a number of articles from the result.

to_.description: Narrows down the results to articles published before the provided date-time in UTC. The format should be `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm`. Example value: `2022-09-18T15:30`. Date-times of the future do not affect the result.

National_team_statistics_api.name: National_team_statistics_api
National_team_statistics_api.description: Fetch the statistics of a national team player using their player ID.

Qrcodepro_api.name: Qrcodepro_api
Qrcodepro_api.description: Generates a professional QR code with customizable properties and settings.

text_.description: The text to encode into the QR code.

validate_.description: Whether to validate the input text. Defaults to None.

setlabel_.description: Whether to set a label on the QR code. Defaults to None.

forecolor_.description: The foreground color of the QR code in hexadecimal format without the # prefix. Defaults to '000000'.

type_.description: The output file type for the QR code ('png', 'svg', or 'eps'). Defaults to 'svg'.

labeltext_.description: The text to use as a label in the QR code. Defaults to None.

size_.description: The size of the output image in pixels, with a maximum of 4000. Defaults to 150.

labelalign_.description: The alignment of the label ('left', 'right', or 'center'). Defaults to 'center'.

backcolor_.description: The background color of the QR code in hexadecimal format without the # prefix. Defaults to 'FFFFFF'.

level_.description: The error correction level of the QR code ('L', 'M', 'Q', 'H'). Defaults to 'M'.

Top_paid_apps_api.name: Top_paid_apps_api
Top_paid_apps_api.description: Fetch the top paid apps chart from Google Play, optionally filtering by category, region, and language. Results can be limited to a specified number of apps.

limit_.description: Limit the number of results. Allowed values are between 1 and 200. Default is 50. Requests with a limit value between 101-200 will be charged double.

category_.description: Get the chart in a specific Google Play category (e.g., 'SOCIAL'). Default is None.

region_.description: The country code to use, specified as a 2-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Default is 'us'.

language_.description: The language to use, specified as a 2-letter ISO 639-1 alpha-2 language code. Default is 'en'.

Models_by_make_id_api.name: Models_by_make_id_api
Models_by_make_id_api.description: Fetch the list of motorcycle models by make ID from the Motorcycle Specs Database.

is_id_.description: The make ID for which to fetch the model list.

Province_api.name: Province_api
Province_api.description: Fetches the average price of gas in a specific province in Canada using the Canadian Gas Prices API.

province_.description: A valid province name in Canada. Options include Ontario, Quebec, Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Newfoundland and Labrador, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, Saskatchewan.

Get_skin_from_uuid_api.name: Get_skin_from_uuid_api
Get_skin_from_uuid_api.description: Fetches the Minecraft skin associated with a given UUID using the Toolbench RapidAPI.

uuid_.description: The UUID of the Minecraft player whose skin is being fetched.

Unfurl_api.name: Unfurl_api
Unfurl_api.description: Fetches and previews metadata for a given URL using the Unfurl API.

url_.description: The URL to be unfurled.

Get_reel_by_shortcode_api.name: Get_reel_by_shortcode_api
Get_reel_by_shortcode_api.description: Fetch information about an Instagram reel using its shortcode.

shortcode_.description: The unique identifier for the Instagram reel.

Get_profile_data_api.name: Get_profile_data_api
Get_profile_data_api.description: Retrieves profile data from the LinkedIn Profile Data API using a given username.

username_.description: The LinkedIn username for which to retrieve profile data.

G_olocaliser_les_partenaires_api.name: G_olocaliser_les_partenaires_api
G_olocaliser_les_partenaires_api.description: Fetch all partners or partners within a specified radius around a given point.

nearbydistance_.description: Radius of the search area in meters. Default is '2000'.

nearbylon_.description: Longitude of the center of the search area. Default is '166.448744'.

nearbylat_.description: Latitude of the center of the search area. Default is '-22.302828'.

Getlearningresourcesbytopic_api_4e07408.name: Getlearningresourcesbytopic_api_4e07408
Getlearningresourcesbytopic_api_4e07408.description: Retrieves Power BI learning resources based on a specified topic and page number.

page_.description: The page number of the learning resources to retrieve.

topic_.description: The topic for which to fetch learning resources.

Currencies_api.name: Currencies_api
Currencies_api.description: Retrieves a list of currencies from the Booking.com API.

language_code_.description: The language code to use for the response. Defaults to 'en-us'.

Get_price_info_for_word_count_api.name: Get_price_info_for_word_count_api
Get_price_info_for_word_count_api.description: Returns price information for translating a given number of words between specified languages and topic using the TextKing API.

words_.description: The number of words to translate.

source_language_.description: ISO 639 language code of the source language.

target_language_.description: ISO 639 language code of the target language.

topic_.description: A topic UUID for the translation context.

Address_api_6b86b27.name: Address_api_6b86b27
Address_api_6b86b27.description: Fetch address information such as postal code or latitude/longitude based on specified search parameters.

coord_unit_.description: The unit of latitude and longitude in the output data. Options are 'degree' (default) or 'millisec'.

datum_.description: Geodetic system of latitude and longitude. Options are 'wgs84' (default) or 'tokyo'.

kana_row_.description: Filter addresses by consonants. Addresses beginning with the specified consonant will be returned. Available only when 'code' is specified.

limit_.description: Specifies the maximum number of response data to return. Minimum value is 1, maximum is 100, default is 10.

level_from_.description: Filters addresses to include only those up to a specified lowest address level (1-7).

level_to_.description: Filters addresses to include only those up to a specified highest address level (1-7).

word_.description: Search keyword. Cannot be used in combination with 'code'. Either 'word' or 'code' must be specified.

code_.description: Address code. Cannot be used in combination with 'word'. Either 'word' or 'code' must be specified.

sort_.description: Order in which to sort addresses. Options are 'lexical', 'level_asc', or 'code_asc' (default).

offset_.description: Skips the first number of data. Minimum value is 0, maximum is 2000, default is 0.

address_filter_.description: Address filter for getting a specific address code. Prefixing the address code with a '-' excludes the relevant address from the response. Available only when 'word' is specified.

Search_api_02d20bb.name: Search_api_02d20bb
Search_api_02d20bb.description: Search for movies, actors, and theaters based on the given search query and optional geographical parameters.

query_.description: The search term or phrase to look for.

longitude_.description: The geographical longitude to narrow down the search.

latitude_.description: The geographical latitude to narrow down the search.

radius_.description: The search radius in miles. Defaults to 50.

zipcode_.description: The postal code to narrow down the search. Defaults to '90002'.

Artists_get_top_songs_api.name: Artists_get_top_songs_api
Artists_get_top_songs_api.description: Fetches the top songs of a specified artist using the Shazam API.

is_id_.description: The unique identifier of the artist, which can be obtained from various Shazam API endpoints.

l_.description: The language code for the response. Defaults to 'en-US'.

Classify_api.name: Classify_api
Classify_api.description: Classifies input text using the IAB taxonomy via RapidAPI and returns the confidence score and IAB classification.

text_.description: The input text to be classified.

Search_api_7688b6e.name: Search_api_7688b6e
Search_api_7688b6e.description: Searches for news articles by query with options to filter the results by country, language, source, and publication time.

query_.description: Search query to retrieve news articles.

country_.description: Country code to limit results to a specific country. Default is 'US'.

lang_.description: Language code to filter results by language. Default is 'en'.

source_.description: Domain of the news source (e.g., cnn.com) to narrow down results.

time_published_.description: Specifies the time range for news articles' publication date.

Teams_list_api_6b86b27.name: Teams_list_api_6b86b27
Teams_list_api_6b86b27.description: Retrieve a list of cricket teams based on the match type using the Cricbuzz API.

matchtype_.description: The type of match to filter teams by. One of the following values: 'international', 'league', 'domestic', or 'women'.

Statistics_esports_api.name: Statistics_esports_api
Statistics_esports_api.description: Fetches esports statistics for a given event using the RapidAPI service.

event_id_.description: The identifier for the esports event.

Getpeople_api_4b22777.name: Getpeople_api_4b22777
Getpeople_api_4b22777.description: Fetches Diablo 4 influencers and top players for a given page number using the provided RapidAPI key.

page_.description: The page number to retrieve data for.

Getfutureevents_api_d4735e3.name: Getfutureevents_api_d4735e3
Getfutureevents_api_d4735e3.description: Fetches future Azure events for a given page number using the provided RapidAPI key.

page_.description: The page number to fetch the future Azure events from.

Get_tides_for_a_station_api.name: Get_tides_for_a_station_api
Get_tides_for_a_station_api.description: Retrieves tide information for a specified station ID on a given date using the RapidAPI NOAA Tides service.

is_id_.description: The ID of the tide station to get information for.

date_.description: The date for which to retrieve tide information in YYYYMMDD format. Defaults to '20220625'.

Movie_suggestions_api.name: Movie_suggestions_api
Movie_suggestions_api.description: Fetches movie suggestions related to a given movie.

movie_id_.description: The ID of the movie for which to get related suggestions. Defaults to 10.

Check_phone_number_api.name: Check_phone_number_api
Check_phone_number_api.description: Checks whether a given phone number is a valid WhatsApp number.

phone_.description: The WhatsApp phone number to be checked, including the country code.

Download_cities_api.name: Download_cities_api
Download_cities_api.description: Downloads a list of cities from the Priceline API.

limit_.description: Limits the number of results returned. Defaults to 500.

resume_key_.description: Key to resume the results from a given ID. Defaults to None.

Webcams_list_exclude_webcamid_webcamid_a.name: Webcams_list_exclude_webcamid_webcamid_api
Webcams_list_exclude_webcamid_webcamid_a.description: This function retrieves a list of webcams excluding the specified webcam IDs.

webcamid_.description: Comma-separated list of webcam IDs to exclude from the result. At least one webcam ID must be provided.

lang_.description: Language code to localize the results, if available. Defaults to 'en'.

show_.description: Content to be included in the response. Possible values are "webcams:image,location". Defaults to 'webcams:image,location'.

Facilities_lookup_api_ef2d127.name: Facilities_lookup_api_ef2d127
Facilities_lookup_api_ef2d127.description: Fetch a list of facilities in Egypt such as hospitals, banks, colleges, etc., based on provided query parameters for type, governorate, city, and limit.

gov_.description: The governorate where the facility is located.

type_.description: The type of facility to search for.

city_.description: The city where the facility is located. Defaults to 'Cairo'.

limit_.description: The maximum number of facilities to query. Defaults to '10'.

Search_all_players_api.name: Search_all_players_api
Search_all_players_api.description: Search for players using a given query string on the Trackmania API.

search_query_.description: The search query used to search for players. Must be at least 4 characters long.

User_tweets_api.name: User_tweets_api
User_tweets_api.description: Fetches a user's tweets using the Twttr RapidAPI.

twttr_proxy_.description: Optional proxy to use for the Twitter API request.

twttr_session_.description: Optional session identifier for the Twitter API request.

cursor_.description: Optional cursor for paginated results.

user_id_.description: The Twitter user ID for which to fetch tweets.

username_.description: The Twitter username for which to fetch tweets (default is 'elonmusk').

Get_by_id_api_d4735e3.name: Get_by_id_api_d4735e3
Get_by_id_api_d4735e3.description: Fetch anime details by their unique ID using the RapidAPI service.

is_id_.description: The unique identifier for the anime.

Blockchain_info_summary_api.name: Blockchain_info_summary_api
Blockchain_info_summary_api.description: Fetches a basic summary of information related to the specified blockchain from the Chain49 API.

blockchain_.description: The name of the blockchain to get information about.

Properties_list_api.name: Properties_list_api
Properties_list_api.description: List properties based on various filters and sorting options.

locationexternalids_.description: The location/externalID fields returned in auto-complete endpoint. Separated by comma for multiple locations. Example: '5002,6020'.

hasfloorplan_.description: Filter properties that have a floor plan. Defaults to None.

areamin_.description: Minimum area of the property. Defaults to None.

purpose_.description: Purpose of the property, either 'for-rent' or 'for-sale'. Defaults to 'for-rent'.

hasvideo_.description: Filter properties that have a video. Defaults to None.

haspanorama_.description: Filter properties that have a panorama. Defaults to None.

furnishingstatus_.description: Furnishing status of the property, either 'unfurnished' or 'furnished'. Defaults to None.

bathsmin_.description: Minimum number of bathrooms. Defaults to None.

sort_.description: Sorting criteria. One of 'price-desc', 'price-asc', 'city-level-score', 'date-desc', 'verified-score'. Defaults to 'city-level-score'.

bathsmax_.description: Maximum number of bathrooms. Defaults to None.

page_.description: Pagination index. Defaults to 0.

agencyexternalids_.description: The externalID fields for agencies. Separated by comma for multiple agencies. Example: '7737,5002'. Defaults to None.

hitsperpage_.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 25.

roomsmin_.description: Minimum number of rooms. Defaults to None.

roomsmax_.description: Maximum number of rooms. Defaults to None.

categoryexternalid_.description: Category ID of the property. Example: 4 for Apartment. Defaults to 4.

rentfrequency_.description: Rent frequency, either 'monthly', 'yearly', 'weekly', or 'daily'. Defaults to 'monthly'.

lang_.description: Language parameter, either 'en' or 'ar'. Defaults to 'en'.

areamax_.description: Maximum area of the property. Defaults to None.

Properties_list_api_6b86b27.name: Properties_list_api_6b86b27
Properties_list_api_6b86b27.description: Fetches a list of properties for sale or rent with various filters and options.

locationname_.description: Name of the location as returned by the auto-complete endpoint.

locationid_.description: ID of the location as returned by the auto-complete endpoint. Should not be used with `zoiid`.

country_.description: Country code, one of "it", "es", "pt". Defaults to "it".

childrenallowed_.description: Specifies if children are allowed. Defaults to None.

floorheights_.description: Floors, separated by commas. Options: "topFloor", "intermediateFloor", "groundFloor". Defaults to None.

hashousekeeper_.description: Indicates if a housekeeper is available. Defaults to None.

couplesallowed_.description: Specifies if couples are allowed. Defaults to None.

garden_.description: Indicates if the property has a garden. Defaults to None.

privatetoilet_.description: Indicates if the property has a private toilet. Defaults to None.

terrace_.description: Indicates if the property has a terrace. Defaults to None.

swimmingpool_.description: Indicates if the property has a swimming pool. Defaults to None.

privateowner_.description: Indicates if the owner is private. Defaults to None.

elevator_.description: Indicates if the property has an elevator. Defaults to None.

airconditioning_.description: Indicates if the property has air conditioning. Defaults to None.

accessible_.description: Specifies if the property is accessible. Defaults to None.

gaypartners_.description: Specifies if gay partners are allowed. Defaults to None.

distance_.description: Radius to look for properties within. Defaults to None.

ispoi_.description: Indicates if the location is a point of interest (works only with `zoiid`). Defaults to None.

q_.description: The search query string, which must be URL-encoded.

Activities_api_6b86b27.name: Activities_api_6b86b27
Activities_api_6b86b27.description: Fetches a list of YouTube channel activity events that match the given request parameters.

regioncode_.description: Instructs the API to return results for the specified country, given as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

with_rt_ratings_.description: If True, includes Rotten Tomatoes ratings in the results.

minimum_rating_.description: An integer between 0 and 9 (inclusive) to filter movies by a given minimum IMDb rating.

limit_.description: An integer between 1 and 50 (inclusive) to limit the number of results per page.

sort_by_.description: A string ('title', 'year', 'rating', 'peers', 'seeds', 'download_count', 'like_count', 'date_added') to sort the results by the chosen value.
